issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (Europe)

plan.diagnosis: Neptune Energy AG represents USD 2,159,071 in annual spend with a resiliency score of only 52 and exposure to 54 sub-tier suppliers in Europe, creating single-source dependency risk at the sub-tier level. The medium severity reflects moderate operational vulnerability despite zero disruption events in the trailing 12 months, indicating latent rather than realized risk. Geographic concentration in the DE/Europe region amplifies supply chain brittleness.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping workshop with Neptune Energy AG to identify the critical single-source sub-tier supplier(s) among the 54 and document dependencies, lead times, and switching barriers
Launch supplier qualification process for at least two alternate sub-tier suppliers in different European geographies or globally to reduce geographic concentration
Negotiate contractual language with Neptune Energy AG requiring sub-tier diversification or buffer inventory for critical components from single-source sub-tier
Establish quarterly sub-tier monitoring cadence with Neptune Energy AG to track resiliency score improvement and early warning indicators
Document alternate sources in ERP systems and implement dual-sourcing strategy for critical materials once qualification complete

plan.expected_impact: Mitigating single-source sub-tier risk protects USD 2,159,071 in annual spend from potential disruption and targets resiliency score improvement from 52 to above 70.
kpis: Number of qualified alternate sub-tier suppliers (target: 2+)
Sub-tier mapping completion rate (target: 100% of critical items)
Time-to-recovery metric for single-source sub-tier failure scenario
risks: Neptune Energy AG may resist sub-tier transparency or lack leverage over sub-tier suppliers
Qualifying alternates may increase cost by 5-15% and extend lead times
Sub-tier switching could require product re-qualification across multiple ERPs
Geographic alternatives outside Europe may introduce new compliance or logistics complexity
erp_actions: SAP: Add info record (ME11) for Neptune Energy AG flagging sub-tier dependency with purchasing organization note in LFA1
SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for alternate sub-tier suppliers once qualified, with quota arrangement (MEQ1) to enforce dual-sourcing
Oracle EBS: Update supplier attributes with risk flag and sub-tier monitoring requirement in PO approval workflow
Coupa: Enable sub-tier risk monitoring module and set resiliency score threshold alert at 60 for Neptune Energy AG
Dynamics 365/NetSuite: Add custom field to vendor master for resiliency score and mandate quarterly updates
All ERPs: Document alternate sources in item master/approved vendor lists once qualification complete (target 120 days)
